newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt yet to decide on extra soy quotas.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt yet to decide on extra soy quotas.

text.p: BANGKOK, Sept 23 (Sept) - The Thai government has not yet made a decision on whether to allow an extra import quota for soymeal and soybean to meet high demand this year, government officials said Monday.

Thai animal feed and oil crushing industries have requested that the soymeal import quota under the government's low tariff programme for 1996 be raised by 200,000 tonnes from the 830,000 tonnes already approved, the officials said.
An official in charge of the soybean quota did not reveal the extra amount requested, but said it was below 100,000 tonnes.
Thai government had already approved the 1996 soybean import quota of 426,460 tonnes.
